_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve mixed_poisson#1, a signal-text correction. The prior text said the normal-flux jump integrand 'vanishes identically'. Measured on 6.2.2604: you do not get zero, you get an exception -- Integrate of (gfu*n - gfu.Other()*n)**2*dx(skeleton=True) on an HDiv GridFunction raises NgException('other mir not set, pls report to developers'), because .Other() is only wired up inside a BilinearForm skeleton assembly, not inside a standalone Integrate. The conformity itself is checked the way that does work: through a skeleton BilinearForm, whose assembled jump energy is at machine zero. The skeleton BilinearForm needs dgjumps=True on the space; without it the assembly raises NgException('SparseMatrixTM::AddElementMatrix: illegal dnums').
